feeds.title: Harold Jarche Blog
feeds.description: Harold Jarche works with individuals, organizations, and public policy influencers to develop practical ways to improve collaboration, knowledge sharing, and sensemaking. feeds.title: Experiencing E-Learning
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Christy Tucker. I'm a learning experience design consultant who combines storytelling and technology to create engaging learning experiences. I create online learning that uses technology and storytelling to draw participants in and let them practice new skills in ways that will easily transfer to their real-life and jobs. If you're tired of boring 'click next' e-learning that doesn't produce the results you need, I can show you a better way.

feeds.title: Julian Stodd's Learning Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Julian Stodd. I am a writer, researcher, Captain at Sea Salt Learning. I help individuals, and organizations, get fit for the social age. I split my time between carrying out community-based research and working with a broad range of communities and Organisations, around the world, helping them to change. I write, and work, around Social Leadership, the reputation-based authority that is granted to us by our own communities. Within this, I study the power structures that underly much of the movement, and conflict, within these complex social systems.

feeds.title: Transfer of Learning Blog
feeds.description: Emma Weber is the founder of Lever -Transfer of Learning, and developer of the Turning Learning into Action methodology. Emma's firm belief, and the platform on which she has built her successful global business, is that the key aim of learning in the workplace is to create tangible business benefits. She established Lever - Transfer of Learning to help organizations and their employees convert learning to effective action back on the job.

feeds.title: Elliott Masie's Learning Trends
feeds.description: Elliott is a provocative, engaging, and entertaining researcher, educator, analyst, and speaker - focused on the changing worlds of corporate learning, organizational performance, and emerging technology. He was the first analyst to use the term 'eLearning' and the host and curator of many Learning & Development Seminars, Labs, and Conferences (including Microsoft TV). Over the past 49 years, he has presented programs, courses, and speeches to over 3,000,000 professionals around the world!
